target_customer: Health AI and life science AI teams that need curated datasets and evals, currently in oncology.
problem: Biomedical AI models lack curated, expert-annotated data and standardized benchmarks, especially in oncology.
business_model: Data licensing and evaluation benchmarks sold to AI developers and health organizations

founders.name: David Chu
founders.background_notes: YC page: recent Brown CS-Econ grad working with health data. The page also names two other team members, John (LinkedIn suggests Finberg) and Will, without titles, so they are not recorded as co-founders.

technical_complexity.rationale: Building and curating pathology and genomic datasets and benchmarks needs data partnerships and annotation workflows more than novel algorithms.

defensibility.rationale: Exclusive access to partner health organization data and pathologist annotations would be hard to copy, though the claims on the company site (2M+ slide images) were not independently verified.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action against Aluna was found; Roche agreed to buy PathAI in 2026 per search results, which shows buyers value pathology data assets.

market_need_then: The company says foundation models in health need curated human data. Demand evidence near mid 2024 was not found in the sources opened.

branding.domain_note: Uses alunadata.com, the name plus data suffix; other companies named Aluna exist, including a respiratory care platform.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand; the name collides with an unrelated healthcare company and the founders ran a separate Fortress launch on the same YC page.

outcome_analysis: Aluna is a three person team that went through YC in Summer 2024 and now sells datasets such as PathFoundry and Duplex plus an OncoBench benchmark still listed as coming soon. No funding, customers or traction were found publicly, so its trajectory cannot be judged. The same YC page carries a Fortress database orchestration launch whose relation to Aluna is unclear.
notes: No funding amount found; the Altss listing mentions family office investors with names hidden. No competitor sources dated near the batch were opened (the HistAI hits are 2025 or later). The 2M+ whole slide image claim is the company's own and unverified.
